purpose: Persist an independent nominal-grid linearized diagnostic and a separate fit to retained failed-run CSVs; do not validate a new physical model or reclassify the failed run.
execution: Only after root reads the complete source. No compiler, native solver, converter, reader, build, Git or old worker is invoked. All output targets must be fresh.

inputs.hash_scope: Verify every consumed CSV against retained Entry hashes; bind retained metadata, input manifest and runtime XML; bind four explicitly frozen formula source files before and after analysis. Do not recursively represent every historic mutable metadata path as current or re-read the full raw BI4/build closure.
inputs.precision: PartVTK text: p/v about seven significant digits, J/sigma about twelve. Header times are display/nominal diagnostic labels, not decoded binary TimeStep. Positions only establish the approximate initial ID-to-layer map; matrices use nominal decimal coordinates.

model.geometry: 100 soil layers z=(i+0.5)dp, ten x-periodic columns, four fixed bottom layers; dp and material read from exact retained runtime XML. Model the x-invariant subspace using horizontal offsets -3..3 at h/dp=1.8. No upper ghost is invented.
model.coefficients: KernelH=float(XML h); bwen=float(-2.7852/double(KernelH)^3); awen=float(.557/double(KernelH)^2); KernelSize=float(2*KernelH), KernelSize2=float(KernelSize*KernelSize), Eta2=float((double(KernelH)*.1)^2). fac reproduces the CPU float sqrt/q/w/product sequence. V0=double(float(massfluid))/double(float(rhop0)); n0/Kw/k/material use production float conversions. K/G use float PR arithmetic; M is float(K+4.*G/3.) as actual elastic K4G3.
model.C: Binary64 inverse of the initial 2x2 x-z moment sum -V0*d tensor gradW, using the FS double displacement and float kernel factor. These are independently reconstructed nominal C, not exported actual CorrMatc.
model.bottom: Exact same-node nominal mirror: pressure/sigma_zz/C diagonal even, velocity_z/Ace_z odd; fixed slots -4..-1 refer to native layers 3..0. This uses the anchored mirror contract in the same-node nominal limit, not arbitrary MLS equivalence.
model.H: a_i=sum_j V0/rho0*(t_i+t_j)*raw_float_gradW_z with t=sigma_zz-p. Pair arithmetic constants retain float displacement/gradient; binary64 matrix accumulation does not reproduce float per-pair accumulation.
model.Dtheta: sum V0*(v_j-v_i)*(Ci gradW)_z, with force-loop float displacement -> double and its float kernel factor. No velocity quantization Jacobian is claimed.
model.Dsigma: Approximate linear coefficient map from float(V0)*raw_float_gradW followed by receiver C. Actual intermediate velocity/stress float rounding is not a differentiable map reproduced by this model.
model.Da: Complete-rate divergence uses double displacement, float kernel factor, receiver Ci and odd acceleration mirror.
model.Lstar: Lp=sum w_ij*(p_i-p_j), Gp=sum V0*(p_j-p_i)*Ci gradW, Lx=sum w_ij*d_ij; w=V0*d dot (Ci+Cj)gradW/(r2+Eta2); Lstar=Lp-Gp_z*Lx_z in the x-invariant subspace.
model.system: v'=H(sigma-p); sigma'=M*Dsigma*v; p'=-B*Dtheta*v+(B*k/gamma)*[Lstar*p+rhow*Da*H(sigma-p)], B=Kw/n0, gamma=rhow*9.80665. J is frozen at 1; no base-load forcing, position/C evolution or actual step is integrated.
diagnostics: modeled current Lstar plus acceleration term
only Lstar replaced by uncorrected Lp
model.no_admission: Every alternative is a diagnostic counterfactual, never a production recommendation or acceptance. Positive growth must be verified against real production operator actions before claiming a root cause. The midpoint polynomial 1+dt*lambda+.5*(dt*lambda)^2 is descriptive, not a production integration replay.

fit.window: Retained parts20..55 inclusive, both top-layer first-column p and vz. Initial ID selected from Part0 nominal coordinates, not hardcoded ID139.
fit.formula: exp(a*(t-tlast))*(c*cos(omega*(t-tlast))+d*sin(omega*(t-tlast)))+e+f*(t-tlast)/window_duration; solve linear c,d,e,f inside nonlinear a/omega least_squares.
fit.independence: Frequency seed comes from the CSV FFT, growth seed from whole-column RMS regression. Do not seed from a matrix eigenvalue or hardcode previously observed growth/frequency. Numerical search bounds derive from window duration and sampling Nyquist; no R-squared/growth acceptance threshold is added.
fit.time: Fit uses the CSV header display times and separately records nominal part*10*DtFixed and their maximum difference. Neither is described as a new binary clock validation.

src/source/JSphCpu.cpp:theta operand around2547-2570; stress gradient and C around2682-2738; elastic K4G3 around2167
src/source/JSphCpu.cpp:wall even/odd reconstruction around4237-4297; full dynamic rate around4377-4456
limitations: No actual C++ Jacobian, second native/BI4 parser, actual force, native clock validation, unsaved-stage exception attribution, half-step acceptance, physical truth, public/gpu admission or proposed equation fix. Preserve failed solver exit1 and the original export-count false; the successful converter and its independent offline review are merely consumed evidence.
